label: input r in the first 4 original positions (plus weak t=1 token detector)
explanation: Fires almost only in the original phase at steps t=0..3 (zero at the delimiter, ~0 in copy phase, nothing at t>=4). Main component (~78% of activation mass): input token r at t<=3, which fires with precision 1.0 and gives the largest activations (r at t=1 ~1.0 of max, r at t=0 ~0.79, r at t=2 ~0.8). Secondary component: weak, broad firing at t=1 (37% of all t=1 steps), graded by token: y/p/b always fire (~0.1-0.2 of max), 1/s/h ~70%, m ~57%, other tokens less often and very weakly (lowest quartile ~0.02-0.05). Does not fire on r after step 3, on repeated/copy-phase inputs, or at the delimiter. The predicate covers 95% of mass at 0.89 precision but misses the long tail of tiny t=1 activations on other tokens.

scorecard.summary: Graded preference over the current input token (most: r, y, p, b, 1, s; least: n, a, z, w) and the previous input (most: r, s, i, x, d, m; least: c, q, 1, z); timing cues that raise it most: t=1, L=3 & t=5, t=2.
